label: sousuruto
title_raw: そうすると [そうすると] (sousuruto)
title: そうすると
meaning: That means, If that's the case, etc
meaning_example: That means that there is no time to drink beer!

examples.japanese: ９時に彼女らと会うのか？　そうするとビールを飲む時間はないんだよ！ くそ！
examples.body_text:
９時に彼女らと会うのか？　そうするとビールを飲む時間はないんだよ！ くそ！ 

		We're meeting the girls at 9? 
		That means 
		there's no time to drink beer! Damnit!
examples.body_html:
９時に彼女らと会うのか？　そうするとビールを飲む時間はないんだよ！ くそ！ 
We're meeting the girls at 9? That means there's no time to drink beer! Damnit!

examples.japanese: そうするといやが上にも美しく見える。
examples.body_text:
そうするといやが上にも美しく見える。 

That 
		makes you much more attractive still.
examples.body_html:
そうするといやが上にも美しく見える。 
That makes you much more attractive still.

comments.text:
doesnt this mean more like "_if_ that's true, then..." - ie based on preceding item.

so your ex # would be:

If thats true, then we dont have time for a drink.

comments.text: 彼女らを should be 彼女らと. Also, "to drink a beer" should be "to drink beer."
comments.html: 彼女らを should be 彼女らと. Also, "to drink a beer" should be "to drink beer."
